title: Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space
summary: Tomas Mikolov, Kai Chen, Greg Corrado, and Jeffrey Dean submitted 'Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space' on January 16, 2013. The paper proposed two model architectures for computing continuous vector representations of words from very large data sets and evaluated the resulting representations on syntactic and semantic word-similarity tasks.
significance: A documented natural-language-processing research milestone introducing two efficient architectures for learning continuous word representations at large scale.

verification.note: The original arXiv record establishes the January 16, 2013 first-submission date, authors, and core paper claims. Google Research independently identifies the work as an ICLR 2013 publication and describes the same two-model contribution.
